name: Magna Polonia S.A.
summary: Magna Polonia S.A., previously known as NFI Magna Polonia S.A., is a Warsaw, Poland-based private equity and venture capital firm. The company specializes in providing capital throughout a business's lifecycle, encompassing seed funding, start-up investments, growth capital, expansion financing, restructuring support, and bridge loans. Its strategic focus is on the telecommunications, broadcasting, and information technology sectors. Geographically, Magna Polonia S.A. prioritizes opportunities within Central and Eastern Europe, with a strong emphasis on Poland. The firm typically commits between €0.5 million ($0.65 million) and €10 million ($13.05 million) to its portfolio companies.
